Subject: Pilot spike — ask for one-time smoothing credit for Clearpath

Marissa,

Quick context: Clearpath (Ellis Park) launched a 6-week pilot last month and usage spiked unexpectedly in week 3 due to an internal demo that leaned heavily on embeddings. Their bill for May would exceed the committed pilot budget by ~220%. They like the product and want to convert, but finance is pushing back on the first-month overage.

Proposal from my side: a one-time "volume smoothing" credit equal to 60% of the overage (approx $28k) to preserve the pilot momentum and secure the expansion PO. This is a one-time concession tied to a 12-month annualization commitment if they sign by end of Q3. Marcus has the numbers in the attached spreadsheet (usage + forecast).

Why this matters: 1) High expansion propensity — execs were engaged during the demo; 2) We have a clear path to CTAs (customer success + SOW) that starts in 30 days; 3) Competitive risk if we push them off now.

Asking for: your sign-off to escalate to VP/CFO with a formal memo (I can draft), and permission to route a conditional term sheet to Clearpath.

Attachments: clearpath-usage-breakdown-q2.xlsx (Marcus) and a draft proposed-credit-term-sheet.pdf (attached placeholder).

Thanks,
Ben
